title: security: rbac v2 KMS region pinning + audit enhancements
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and include KMS region metadata in audit logs. Migration tool included for existing policies. Backwards compatible check mode available via feature flag.
description:
Motivation: Customers using Private and Dedicated deployments need stronger enforcement around KMS key residency and clear auditability of key usage. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation, surfaces KMS region metadata in audit logs, and provides a migration path for existing policies.

What this change does: 1) Policy enforcer now evaluates a new constraint type `kms_region_pin` on RBAC v2 role bindings. The constraint supports single-region and region-set semantics (e.g., eu-west-1 or [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]). 2) Audit service schema extended to include `kms_region` and `kms_key_alias` fields; all KMS operations now emit these fields to central audit stream. 3) Policy migration CLI (`rbac-migrate-kms`) converts legacy KMS residency annotations into explicit RBAC constraints and emits a dry-run report. 4) Installer updates: Private installer injects KMS region validation webhook during bootstrap for on-prem clusters. 5) Tests: unit + integration + e2e (policy enforcer <-> audit service) added; small perf regression test added and flagged.

Checklist: - [x] Implement policy_enforcer KMS constraint evaluation - [x] Add audit fields and backfill mapping - [x] Migration CLI and docs - [x] Administrator-facing docs and release notes - [x] Integration tests - [x] Security scan and vuln fixes

Migration notes: The migration tool defaults to dry-run and emits a CSV mapping of old annotations to new constraints. Operators must review the report and run with `--apply` to persist changes. A feature flag `rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce` controls enforcement vs audit-only behavior to permit staged rollouts.

Backward compatibility: When the feature flag is off enforcement is disabled and the system only emits audit events for mismatches. We validated the flag path in the integration tests and included a toggle in the console config for Dedicated customers.

Performance: Constraint evaluation adds a small constant cost per policy check; we added a caching layer keyed by (account,kms_region) to minimize repeated resolver calls. Benchmarks included in the PR show a median policy check latency increase of ~1.6ms on heavy multi-constraint policies; acceptable under our p95 SLOs for control-plane ops.

Security review: encryption and key alias lookups happen using existing KMS client with least-privilege SPA credentials. Audit fields are scrubbed to avoid logging raw plaintext key material.

Notes for reviewers: focus on policy_enforcer change and audit schema diffs. Migration CLI is intentionally small and idempotent; please sanity-check edge cases around wildcard region annotations.

Related: ENG-4312 (policy rollout), SEC-1021 (KMS residency compliance), SUP-9842 (customer support ticket linking).
commits: Add kms_region_pin constraint evaluation to policy enforcer (core change)
Extend audit schema + emit kms_region and kms_key_alias for KMS ops
Add rbac-migrate-kms CLI with dry-run and apply modes
Installer: inject validation webhook for Private installer
Add integration and e2e tests for enforcer <-> audit service
review_threads: Maya: Do we validate region format (aws region vs canonical)? Suggest using normalized region code in migration.
Priya: Migration normalizes to canonical AWS region codes using the region-mapper util; added tests.
Alex: Concern about audit schema bloat; can we make kms_* fields optional and only present for KMS ops?
Priya: kms_* fields are emitted only on KMS-related audit events; schema change is additive and optional for consumers.
Diego: Installer webhook may cause bootstrap failures if KMS API unreachable; recommend fallback mode.
Priya: Added `validateOnBootstrap` flag (defaults to true) and a `--skip-kms-check` bootstrap flag for air-gapped installs; documented in installer notes.

Schedule migration run with ops for 3 pilot customers
Add dashboard panels to track KMS-region audit events
notes: Hotfix path considered: we included a rollback by flipping `rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce=false`. Manual rollback steps documented in CHANGELOG.
